high_level_description: The image depicts a person standing in front of a retail store shelf, which is stocked with various products such as bottles of Coca-Cola, Aquafina water, and other beverages. The individual appears to be observing the items on the shelf, possibly considering a purchase. To the right of the person, there is a large monitor displaying a video feed from a security camera. The video feed shows the same person from behind, standing near the same shelf with the same products. The monitor also includes some text and graphics, indicating that the system is tracking the person's actions.
